label: Metaphysics IX.8 supports substance priority of actuality
note: The substance-priority argument takes actuality as the end of capacities and uses mature form; the actual agent examples occur in the temporal argument. The route needs an actual bearer in the same respect for every admitted POTENCY_1 instance, related by its binary substance-and-perfection priority predicate. A capacity's reference to its exercise or its end does not itself supply that bearer.
